name: Do wall repairs and drywall patching need to be done before interior painting?

mainEntity.name: Do wall repairs and drywall patching need to be done before interior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall damage, settling cracks, and water stains must be fully repaired and primed before any paint goes on the wall. Applying finish paint directly over unpatched holes or loose tape will leave visible surface flaws and cause premature peeling. Because our crew handles both professional drywall repair and finish painting in-house, we inspect sheetrock for soft spots, patch holes, re-tape joints, and sand everything flush before priming. This eliminates the delay of hiring separate drywallers and painters.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. All wall cracks, holes, and sheetrock flaws should be patched, sanded, and primed before painting to ensure smooth, long-lasting coverage.
